DUPLICATE of `mesodermic-vaporish-seaslug` (`0d15-59a4-e140-444b`) — closing.

That ticket is the compaction lane's own `discovered_from` bug for the same defect ("Sweep walks full git history per ticket under the store lock"), it is already `in_progress`, and its fix is Gerrit **1739**, in review now: one history walk per sweep hoisted OUTSIDE the lock, scoped staging, and a mid-run re-yield — which covers both halves of what I described (the per-event `git log --full-history` cost AND the stand-aside probe running only once, before the lock is taken).

I filed this independently after hitting it from an unrelated lane, without finding the existing ticket first. The concrete field evidence — 24+ minutes at 0.0% CPU, two blocked closes, a sweep spawned by a different worktree blocking this one, and the observed leading-wildcard pathspec command — has been carried over as a comment on seaslug, along with two suggestions that may sit outside 1739's scope (making the lock holder identify itself as optional housekeeping, and surfacing the "a skipped sweep is a no-op" guarantee somewhere a blocked operator would actually see it).

Nothing here needs to stay open. Linked `duplicates` seaslug.
